artboards.title: System A — one channel per question
Depth grid — a later second view

annotations.text:
THE BOARD — building this.
Formation shape, one stack per slot, first choice on top. Squad and lists in the panel on the right; unwanted players stay visible there.

SYSTEM A — the card rules.
Fill says WHERE (he does not play here), the left edge says he is a target off a list, glyphs say WHO. One tint, one meaning.

DEPTH GRID — parked as a second view.
Same slots, same stacks, same cards: rows are slots, columns are first / second / third choice. A tab over the board's data rather than a separate feature, so it can be added without re-modelling anything.

SYSTEM C — parked as a second look.
Tint by how much is wrong rather than what. The card data does not change, only the rule that colours it.
